description.zh:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签。当请求中未设置 `TagKey`时，该参数才有效。取值范围：

- true
- false

默认值：false
description.en:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resource. This parameter is valid only when `TagKey` is not set in the request. Valid values:

- true

- false

Default value: false

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The ID of the region where the resource resides.

description.zh:
资源类型。取值范围：

- ContainerGroup：ECI实例
- ImageCache：镜像缓存
- DataCache：数据缓存
- VirtualNode：虚拟节点
description.en:
The resource type. Valid values:

- ContainerGroup: ECI instance

- ImageCache: image cache

- DataCache: data cache

- VirtualNode: virtual node

description.zh: 要解绑的标签键列表。最多可输入20个标签键。
description.en: A list of tag keys to detach. You can enter up to 20 tag keys.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000 --tag-key testkey --resource-type ContainerGroup --all false --client-token 123e4567-xxx-xxx-xxxx-42665544xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000' --TagKey.1 testkey --ResourceType ContainerGroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-xxx-xxx-xxxx-42665544xxxx'
